textos.texto: Right. Ten seconds palm down and ten palm up, easing your fingers toward you with your other hand.
Take care · If keeping your arms on the wall strains your posture, let them come off a little. No wall? Do it in the air.
Cuídate · Talón apoyado. Baja solo hasta donde controles.
Cuídate · La rodilla de apoyo algo flexionada. Sin rebotes.
Take care · Don't squeeze hard. Keep breathing normally.
Take care · Too hard? Use the wall, hands at chest height. The desk must not move: no wheels, nothing folding.
Cuídate · Si cuesta, en la pared, manos a la altura del pecho. Mesa fija: ni con ruedas ni plegable.
Hang and draw your shoulders slightly away from your ears, without bending your elbows.
Take care · A light, undamaged band, firmly underfoot; don't let go while it's taut. No band? Skip this step.
Take care · Don't push them back with your other hand.
Take care · Lean on something if you lose your balance.

textos.texto: Cuídate · Elige una altura que te deje respirar tranquilo.
Take care · Keep a comfortable support and come out with control. If your heels lift, go less deep.
Derecha. Avanza la pelvis unos centímetros, sin arquear la cintura. Estirón suave en la ingle de atrás.
Izquierda. Avanza la pelvis unos centímetros, sin arquear la cintura. Estirón suave en la ingle de atrás.
Cuídate · Una mano en la mesa o la pared si pierdes el equilibrio. Baja solo hasta donde controles.
Take care · Gentle: this is not a strength exercise.
Boca arriba, rodillas dobladas, pies apoyados al ancho de las caderas y cerca de los glúteos.
Has cerrado un bloque. Elige tu pausa.
Left. Ten seconds palm down and ten palm up, easing your fingers toward you with your other hand.
Take care · The turn comes from the trunk, not the neck.
Take care · A soft stretch at the front of the back hip, never a sharp pull. Hold the desk if you need to.
